sources.notes: Published DS library variables. Colour + type + spacing.
v4. Logo + claims chapters current; imagery chapter predates the 2026 grade.

identity.positioning: Precision tools for people who take the work seriously.
identity.audience: Professional and serious amateur makers, 28-55. Buy once, keep for decades.

competitors_avoided.name: Voltcraft
competitors_avoided.why: High-saturation gradients and floating hero products read as consumer-cheap.

competitors_avoided.name: Bldr
competitors_avoided.why: Lifestyle-first, tool-second. Ours is the opposite — the tool is the subject.

principles.statement: The product is always shown in use, never floating.
Materials read honestly — steel looks like steel, no chrome fantasy.
We show the work, not the lifestyle around the work.

rules.statement: Core palette is Bone #F4F1EC, Ink #101418 and Amber #E8A33D. Fills outside these sit under the accent share cap.
exceptions: Photographic content within imagery is exempt; this governs graphic fills.
rules.fix_hint: Map the off-palette fill to the nearest core colour, or justify it as photographic content.

rules.statement: Pure black #000000 is never used. Ink #101418 is the darkest value.
exceptions: Print CMYK builds where registration black is a production requirement.

rules.statement: Amber #E8A33D is an accent and covers no more than 10% of any canvas.
exceptions: Packaging end-frames, where amber is the ground by design.
rules.fix_hint: Reduce the amber field to a supporting element; take large grounds to Bone #F4F1EC.

rules.statement: Type sits on the scale: 12, 14, 16, 20, 24, 32, 44, 60px. No intermediate sizes.
rules.fix_hint: Snap to the nearest scale step; pick the larger one when hierarchy is at stake.

rules.statement: Logo clear space is at least 1x the wordmark cap-height on all four sides.
rules.fix_hint: Increase the margin to 1x cap-height, or drop to the mark-only lockup at tight widths.

rules.statement: The product sits off-centre with copy in the resulting negative space. Centred hero compositions are not used.

check.rubric: 4 = off-centre with copy occupying the negative space, as ex-p-04. 2 = neutral crop, no clear strategy. 0 = centred hero with symmetric copy, as ex-n-02.

exceptions: Square social crops where the placement forces symmetry.
rules.fix_hint: Shift the product to a third; move copy into the opposing negative space.

rules.statement: Comparative and superlative performance claims carry approved substantiation on the same surface.

required: substantiation footnote when a comparative claim is present

rules.fix_hint: Add the approved substantiation line, or rewrite to a non-comparative claim.

rules.statement: Product names are written exactly as the range sheet lists them, including spacing and case.
Headlines state a fact about the tool. They do not use wordplay, exclamation, or second-person hype.

check.rubric: 4 = plain declarative fact about the tool, as ex-p-07. 2 = neutral but generic. 0 = pun, exclamation, or 'you' hype, as ex-n-05.

rules.fix_hint: Rewrite as a plain statement about what the tool does or is made of.

rules.statement: Meta feed placements are delivered 4:5 rather than 1:1.
rules.fix_hint: Supply a 1080x1350 crop alongside the square.

rules.statement: Logos, packaging copy and any legible in-frame text are composited from real assets, never generated.
rules.fix_hint: Composite the real logo/pack art over the generation, or remove the text from frame.

rules.statement: Generated imagery keeps the brand's single-source directional light. Default model rim-lighting and over-smooth surfaces are corrected before delivery.

check.rubric: 4 = matches the corpus grade, single light source, honest material. 2 = neutral studio light. 0 = double rim-light, plastic sheen, HDR local contrast, as ex-n-09.

rules.fix_hint: Re-prompt with the corpus lighting description, or grade the output back to the brand curve.

positive.why: Canonical: tool in a working hand, off-centre right, single window light, copy in the left negative space.
Headline reads 'Forged in one piece.' — a plain fact about the tool, no wordplay.
Amber used as a 6% accent on the price flash only; ground stays Bone.
Generated and used: single-source light, honest steel, matches the corpus grade.

negative.why: Killed in review: tool floating and centred on an amber gradient. Review note: 'this is Voltcraft'.
Killed: headline 'Get a grip on your weekend!' — pun plus exclamation plus second person.
Discarded generation: double rim-light and plastic sheen on the steel. Reads as stock 3D.

open_questions.question: Is 4:5 actually the standard for Meta feed, or did the 1:1 deliveries reflect a client request? Only 4 of 7 delivered assets were 4:5.
Does the #000000 ban extend to print CMYK builds, where registration black may be a production requirement?
Guide v4's imagery chapter specifies a cool grade, but all 34 AW26 assets use a warm one. Which is current?
